dedupe_keys.name: aides communales renovation energetique energie renouvelable et electromobilite

description: Aides communales rénovation énergétique, énergie renouvelable et électromobilité is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klima-Agence G.I.E.. Inventory of municipal aid for energy renovation, the use of renewable energies and electromobility for individuals. The inventory is the basis for simulating national and municipal aid on the website aides.klima-Agence.lu. Coverage: Klima-Agence G.I.E.. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal aid for energy renovation, renewable energy and electromobility" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klima-Agence G.I.E.. Its keywords include commune, aides-communales, renovation-energetique, communes, aides-nationales, aides-etatiques. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other-open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
